text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
'Sup. Happy New Year, Trainie. Looking 
forward to working with you this year too. 
Woo-hoo.

—The New Year. While many Umamusume 
returned home or went on trips...
choice_data_list: You've been here the whole time, Tran.
You've been here the whole time, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. Being right here is where 
I feel most at peace.
choice_data_list:
How about doing some New Year's 
calligraphy, at least?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Kakizome, huh... Ah, truth is, I 
already...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy. Take a look at the PC monitor 
on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I already wrote it there.
choice_data_list: With a brush, on the display!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no no. Digital. As in, digital 
first calligraphy of the year.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They've got handy stuff like that these 
days. But what I wrote is pretty serious, 
ya know~.

Prompted by the remark, I look at the 
screen. And there, the text written on it 
was—
“Escaping the Everyday”
choice_data_list:
Escape the mundane... Is this your 
resolution?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I mean, thanks to meeting you last 
year, Train-chan, I got to have quite a 
few thrilling moments, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So this year, I'm hoping for even more 
thrills. I wanna get thrilled myself, and 
give everyone around me some chills and 
thrills while I'm at it, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy. By the way... what do you 
think is “our biggest enemy of all”?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Yep. It's something everyone wishes would 
just disappear. What do you think it is?"

"...No matter how much I think, nothing 
comes to mind. Yet as I kept pondering..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The answer is... the opposite of what I 
wrote on New Year's. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Boring daily life." I mean, everyday life 
where only predictable things happen is 
just so dull.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna feel thrilled all the 
time, and eradicate boredom from this 
world completely.

Transcend's philosophy was consistent. The 
countless interactions, the unpredictable 
races— all of it was to escape a boring 
everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainy-poo. How about we escape our 
daily routine for New Year's and dive into 
a wondrous world?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Being the info-savvy girl I am, I happen 
to know a few really mysterious rumors, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Why don't we investigate the truth behind 
it?
choice_data_list:
Like ghost stories or the school's seven 
mysteries?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. There are all kinds— from 
creepy-sounding ones to ones that seem to 
have scientific backing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, choice time. Which rumor's 
truth do you wanna chase after?
choice_data_list:
A painting that changes depending on who 
looks at it.
A room where you could sleep forever
The Rose Garden That Never Withers

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A painting that changes depending on who 
looks at it", huh... Come to think of it, 
at a certain museum...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's a painting where the person 
depicted changes depending on who looks at 
it. Let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Gather 'round, gather 'round, ladies and 
gentlemen. This painting, said to have 
been made in Ireland..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
To me, it kinda looks like an "old man" is 
depicted here, though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tran-san. Yahoo, it's Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well. The adorable horse girl, 
Curren. Who does this painting look like 
to you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's drawn on it...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Grandpa"... is what you mean, right? I 
think it's pretty obvious just by looking 
at him, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see... Just like me, it's their grandpa. 
Then what about the other Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hello, Tran-san.

Next to arrive was the fashionista, North 
Flight.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's not your grandpa, is it? No 
matter how you look at it, what's drawn 
here is...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I believe it's someone's "Papa," though.
From North Flight's perspective... a dad.

"Next to arrive was the young lady of the 
Splendid Clan, Daiichi Ruby."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
She looks like a charming "young 
gentleman" to me, however.

From Daiichi Ruby's perspective... a young 
man.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, who does it look like to you, 
Trainy?

Prompted by the words, I turn my eyes 
toward the painting—

There was no one depicted in the painting, 
only an expanse of rolling pasture.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's quite curious, isn't it? Such 
mysteries do happen from time to time. 
Just who was depicted in that painting?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Your hint is "Irish paintings." Give it 
some thought, Trainer-chan.

The mystery deepens... Still, it made for 
a good mental workout for all of us.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A ‘Room Where You Can Sleep Forever’, 
huh... Come to think of it, somewhere..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, there's a room that induces 
eternal slumber. Shall we go look for it?"
(Rattle, rattle, click)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right here. This must be the place. 
...Such a soothing scent. And on the 
shelf...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The latest crowdfunding merch! Man, this 
is the best. I could stay here forever.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. You're always loafing around the 
Trainer's office anyway, so being here is 
pretty much the same thing~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna spend New Year's right 
here. Well, g'night~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Zzz...

And so, throughout the New Year's 
holidays, Transcend lazed around in this 
room so much it made you wonder, "How can 
anyone sleep that much?!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Unwithering Rose Garden', huh? Come 
to think of it, even in an out-of-season 
winter..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a rose garden that's 
in bloom year-round. Want to take a peek?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it is, right here. It's true. 
Even though it's winter, the roses are in 
bloom...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What does this mean? Just what kind of 
magic has been cast...?

A silhouette approaching. That person 
is...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. The reason they're always in 
bloom is because I take good care of them.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, grandma did?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yep. So that when my grandkids come visit 
someday, I can show it to them.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... So it was only possible 
because of grandma's magical touch...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Since you've come all this way, would you 
like to help tend to them together? We 
even have a new breed of rose.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A new species! Oh, absolutely. Show it to 
us, Trai-chan!

And so, by helping out the mysterious 
elderly Umamusume, I learned all sorts of 
things about roses and improved my manual 
dexterity.
